A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DGPPO research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A-D. Their equations, figures, tables and corresponding experiments support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original multi-agent simulation results, including baseline comparisons, ablations, generalization experiments and a deadlock case study in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original simulation results, including the main comparisons and the additional experiments in Appendices B-D.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1-4.5 retain the same DGCBF construction, stochastic and deterministic rollouts, gradient projection, weight scheduling and PPO update. No algorithmic component or model architecture changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate TARGET, SPREAD, LINE, BICYCLE, TRANSPORT, WHEEL and TRANSPORT2, plus the two Safe HalfCheetah tasks in Appendix C.7. The generalization and deadlock test scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: The InforMARL penalty and scheduling variants, MAPPO-Lagrangian variants, and ablation comparators remain unchanged in their corresponding experiments. Both versions also compare against GCBF+ in Figure 15.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, 32 initial conditions per run, training budgets, agent configurations and Appendix C settings are unchanged. The Lagr(lr) learning rate remains 0.1; its adjacent superscript footnote changes from 3 to 4, not the numerical setting.

E4.justification: Both retain the hyperparameter, rollout, learned-CBF and gradient-update ablations, extra-data controls, generalization analysis and deadlock case study in Section 5.3 and Appendices B-D. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Section 5.2 reports three seeds in both versions. Mean and standard-deviation reporting, error bars and uncertainty bands remain unchanged, with no added statistical procedures or revised run counts.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted curves and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 retains the 512-agent safety rate of 0.985 ± 0.123 and normalized cost of 1.821 ± 0.390.

T1.justification: The DCBF/DGCBF definitions, theoretical statements, Appendix A proofs and Appendix B loss derivations are unchanged. The edit to the Ahmadi citation in Appendix A.6 changes citation formatting, not mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about learning safe distributed policies under unknown discrete-time dynamics, handling changing neighborhoods and achieving strong performance with fixed hyperparameters.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and mechanism explanations are retained. Section 6 preserves the sample-efficiency, stochastic-dynamics and practical safety-guarantee limitations; Appendix C.8 retains the restriction concerning substantially higher agent densities.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains identical hardware, training times, implementation details, hyperparameter tables and code access information. The additional author contacts and publication notices do not change the documented technical resources or reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: The bibliography contains the same works, and the positioning relative to CBF safety filters and safe multi-agent RL is unchanged. Reference entries shift across pages, while citation punctuation and related-work wording receive only editorial corrections.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited wording, grammar and punctuation edits, updates affiliation markers and author emails, and expands funding attribution and publication-rights notices. The section order, appendix organization and scientific narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adjusts DGPPO typography in the Figure 4-5 captions and adds a front-page distribution footnote. The longer acknowledgement and rights notice reflow the references. All 15 figures and three tables retain their substantive content and organization.

improvement.justification: v3 provides light copyediting and fuller contact, funding and publication notices. These tidy presentation but leave the explanations, proofs, experimental evidence, reproducibility information and limitations essentially unchanged, including throughout the appendices. The edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
